title: Group of Women Outside House, 1940s B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A black and white snapshot from around the mid-1940s depicting a large gathering of eleven women and one small child posed outdoors in the front yard of a two-story wooden clapboard house with a shaded front porch. The women are dressed in mid-century daytime dresses, floral prints, and home-sewn fashions characteristic of World War II era America. Three women and a young toddler girl sit on the grass while eight women stand in a row behind them, framed by trees and rural architectural details.
